items.name: Design methodology
items.when_to_use: Create from scratch: brief → direction → structure → place → self-check; route craft skills from catalog
items.prompt_positive:
# Design methodology

Process: **brief → direction → structure → place → self-check**.
This skill is the **step skeleton** — not a typography encyclopedia.

Mature craft (product design process + Anthropic skill routing): commit once, pull **1–3** catalog skills, execute with tool_ops.

Visual craft (type, contrast, overflow, decoration): `need_skills` from the **Skills catalog** whose when_to_use matches (enabled only; never invent keys). Prefer **1–3** tightly matched skills — do not spray the catalog.

## Principles
1. **Brief before paint** — deliverable, audience, size, must-have copy.
2. **Direction once** — one aesthetic + one signature focus end-to-end.
3. **Route to playbooks** — deliverable/UI skills own layer order; this skill owns the sequence.
4. **Frame first** on fixed sizes — never fake an artboard with a full-bleed bg rect.
5. **Honesty** — never invent price/phone/logo/testimonials.

## Brief (one line in thought)
Name deliverable, audience/job, size, and must-have copy. Ask if missing; never invent price/phone/logo.

## Direction (commit once)
Pick **one** aesthetic and keep it end-to-end (minimal / editorial / industrial / organic / luxury / festive hand / playful geometric …).
Spend boldness on **one** signature focus; keep surroundings quiet.
Avoid AI-default looks unless the brief asks: purple-on-white gradients; Inter/Roboto/Arial stacks; warm-cream + terracotta serif cliché; hairline broadsheet pastiche; glow + pill spam.

Also pull `garden_style` / `frontend_ui` when taste and anti-slop matter.

## Deliverables → layer order
- **website / landing**: nav → hero (thesis) → benefits → CTA → footer; also `need_skills` **landing_page**
- **product UI / SaaS chrome / settings**: `need_skills` **frontend_ui** (+ **shadcn_ui** when dense controls)
- **dashboard / admin / console**: `need_skills` **dashboard_ui** (+ **frontend_ui**)
- **mobile app / H5 screens**: `need_skills` **mobile_app_ui** (+ **frontend_ui**); single column; thumb-zone CTA; 8pt rhythm
- **ecommerce hero / PDP**: subject-first modules → `need_skills` **ecommerce_surface**
- **Banner**: copy in middle safe band; strong contrast; side quiet zones
- **poster / roll-up / 易拉宝**: `need_skills` **poster_craft** — create_image hero first; never fake with shape piles
- **resume / 简历**: `need_skills` **resume_layout** — scannable columns, no festive decoration
- **icon set**: one stroke/fill language; constructive vector (shape + boolean_op + pen); equal cells; labels under marks
- **motion / Lottie**: `need_skills` **motion_lottie** — not a static-icon substitute
- **brush / pencil / 板绘**: `need_skills` **brush_ops**

Craft gate: also `need_skills` **ui_ux_pro_max** when polishing. Brand sheet: **awesome_design_md**.

## Structure (before heavy place)
In thought: 2–4 zone wireframe (who sits where). One hero zone dominates.
Fixed size (poster/mobile/H5/banner/login) → MUST `create_frame` first at WxH with a name, then place ALL content inside. Never fake an artboard with a full-bleed bg rect. Exception only if the user refuses a frame (不要画板/自由画布/不要 create_frame).

## Place
- Board/page fill → `create_shape` full-bleed rect **inside** the frame. Do **not** use `set_canvas_background` for artboard fills.
- Poster/festive/illustrated: hero image first, then text on quieter regions.
- Hierarchy: one primary title; supporting copy clearly smaller.
- Type: catalog face ~≥90% match → `create_text`+fontFamily; else display/hero lettering → `create_image`+letteringText. Never invent font names.
- Icons: primitives + `boolean_op` / pen; `create_svg`/`create_icon` only for simple marks.
- Node ids only from SCENE.

## Attachments
User images → also `need_skills` **vision_extract**. Finished poster refs = style reference (see that skill).

## Self-check (before done)
- [ ] Direction still coherent (no second competing palette/type mood)
- [ ] Poster/festive: real hero image, not shape collage
- [ ] Title fully inside board; margins OK; contrast OK
- [ ] No emoji tofu / junk Material icons as festive props
- [ ] Copy language matches the user
- [ ] Routed playbooks loaded (1–3 keys) when deliverable matched
items.prompt_negative: Do not dump tool_ops when key info is missing; do not invent prices/phones/logos; do not invent skill keys; do not expand coordinate cheat-sheets here; do not ship long essays in reply; do not invent fontFamily outside Available fonts; do not substitute shape piles for poster heroes; do not skip create_frame on fixed-size jobs unless the user refused a frame; do not use set_canvas_background for artboard fills; do not need_skills every catalog entry; do not use create_image/create_svg when user asked for Lottie; do not use create_lottie for static icons; do not mix two aesthetic directions.

items.name: Vision extract
items.when_to_use: User attached images: classify deliverable; extract layout, palette, type mood; decide style-transfer vs cutout
items.prompt_positive:
# Vision extract

Only describe what is **visible**. Do not invent modules, prices, or copy that are not in the image.

Mature craft (design critique + reference transfer): extract structure and roles, then choose a transfer mode before paint.

## Principles
1. **Visible only** — no invented SKUs, prices, or slogans.
2. **Regions before pixels** — top/mid/bottom or grid occupancy first.
3. **Pick a transfer mode** — style-only / subject-cutout / layout-only — before ops.
4. **Lettering honesty** — ≥90% font match or regenerate lettering; never random calligraphy mapping.
5. **Short extraction** — keep thought tight; paint via tool_ops.

## Extract (fill mentally before paint)
1. **Deliverable**: hero / PDP / Banner / poster / roll-up / web|App UI / illustration|icon
2. **Regions**: top / mid / bottom (or grid); rough % occupancy
3. **Elements**: subject, badges, CTAs, chrome, decorative props
4. **Palette**: 3–5 hex (roles: bg / subject / accent / type)
5. **Type mood**: display vs body; brush/custom vs geometric UI sans
6. **Size/aspect**: suggest WxH when canvas is auto
7. **Transfer mode** (pick one):
   - **style-only**: finished poster/design with baked text → do NOT full-bleed `create_image(attachmentIndex)` (double text). Rebuild with genPrompt bg/subject + `create_text` for UI/body
   - **subject-cutout**: user photo/product → `attachmentIndex` as a layer; build layout around it
   - **layout-only**: keep regions/hierarchy; restyle palette/type

## Lettering on refs
Hero/main title on the ref: catalog font only if ~**≥90%** similar (weight, structure, mood, language). Below that → `create_image` genPrompt + `letteringText` (plain plate / transparent cutout). Do not map 「书法感/手写/国潮」 to a random calligraphy font by default.

## Route after extract
| Seen deliverable | Prefer skill |
|------------------|--------------|
| Poster / festive | `poster_craft` + `image_gen` |
| Ecommerce hero/PDP | `ecommerce_surface` |
| UI chrome | `frontend_ui` / `dashboard_ui` / `mobile_app_ui` |
| Landing | `landing_page` |
| Resume | `resume_layout` |

## Do not
- Paste a finished composite full-bleed when text is baked in (double text)
- Invent missing modules to “complete” the ref
- Treat every ref as a subject-cutout

## Output discipline
Keep extraction short in thought; paint via tool_ops. Prefer clean genPrompt backgrounds over pasting a finished composite as the whole board.

## Done when
Transfer mode chosen; palette/roles noted; lettering path decided; no invented facts.
items.prompt_negative: Do not invent prices, copy, or modules absent from the image. Do not paste a finished poster attach as a full-bleed layer. Do not hardcode calligraphy mood → a single catalog calligraphy font for hero titles.

items.name: Canvas edit
items.when_to_use: Edit existing canvas: add/recolor/rewrite/move/align/clear; brush/Lottie also need brush_ops / motion_lottie
items.prompt_positive:
# Canvas edit

Surgical changes on an **existing** SCENE. Prefer `update_node` / `move_nodes` / `resize_nodes` over delete+recreate.

Mature craft (Figma-style surgical edit + non-destructive refine): preserve structure, match neighbors, never invent ids.

## Principles
1. **Same id when possible** — update beats delete+create.
2. **Preserve structure** — hero whitespace, PDP module order, banner mid-band.
3. **Match neighbors** — missing size/color → borrow stroke, radius, type scale.
4. **Route specialized edits** — brush → `brush_ops`; motion → `motion_lottie`.
5. **Clear honestly** — delete nodes or frames; never fake-clear with a cover rect.

## Decision
1. **Local property** (fill, stroke, text, fontSize, opacity) → `update_node` same id
2. **Position/size** → `move_nodes` / `resize_nodes` (or update x/y/w/h)
3. **Add sibling** → `create_*` inside FOCUS frame; match existing spacing/radius language
4. **Type change** (rect→circle) → `update_node` shapeType; keep id — do not delete+create
5. **Brush / 板绘** → `need_skills` **brush_ops**
6. **Lottie / motion** → `need_skills` **motion_lottie** (never swap for create_image)

## Preserve structure
| Surface | Keep |
|---------|------|
| Hero / poster | Subject + whitespace; do not crowd the focal zone |
| PDP / ecommerce | Module order |
| Banner | Copy in the safe mid-band |
| Dashboard | Shell regions; do not scramble sidebar/KPI/main |
| Resume | Column edges and section order |
| Icons | Refine with `boolean_op` / pen / stroke; do not dump random `create_svg` unless asked |

## Defaults
Missing size/color → match neighboring nodes (same stroke weight, radius, type scale). Node ids **only** from SCENE / FOCUS.

## Clear / wipe board
- Clear content → `delete_nodes` with **all** SCENE node ids (Ask: propose then Confirm)
- Delete artboard/page itself → `delete_frame` only when asked
- NEVER fake-clear with a full-bleed opaque cover rect

## Do not
- Create an empty frame just to edit locals
- Redesign unrelated boards
- Invent ids
- Rebuild a brush hero as ellipse piles
- Replace requested Lottie with a static image

## Done when
Requested change applied; structure preserved; neighbor language matched; SCENE ids only.
items.prompt_negative: Do not create an empty frame for local edits; do not delete+create to change type; do not fake-clear with a cover rect; do not replace requested Lottie with create_image.

items.name: Image generation
items.when_to_use: Poster/hero bitmap, genPrompt backgrounds, materials, or stylized lettering as image
items.prompt_positive:
# Image generation

Use `create_image` with `genPrompt` (or `prompt`) for bitmaps — not editable `create_text` nodes.

Mature craft (prompt craft + poster hero discipline + lettering cutout): concrete subject/style/light/composition; honest typography gate.

## Principles
1. **Hero honesty** — festive/illustrated boards start with full/near-full `create_image`, not shape piles.
2. **Typography gate (~90%)** — catalog face or lettering image; never invent font names.
3. **Concrete prompts** — subject, medium, light, composition, color, negatives.
4. **Stacking** — image first, then type/chrome on quieter regions.
5. **No invented facts** inside the picture (logos, prices, phones) unless asked / letteringText.

## When
- **Poster / festive / illustrated hero**: always start with full or near-full-board `create_image` hero. Shape piles are not done.
- **Photo / product / material / atmosphere** backgrounds.
- **Display lettering** that fails the typography gate below.

## Typography gate (~90%)
Compare needed title look (USER_PROMPT + refs) to Available fonts:
- ~**≥90%** similar → `create_text` + fontFamily
- Below — especially hero/main titles → `create_image` + genPrompt + `letteringText` on a plain solid plate (hydrate cutout). Do **not** map 书法感/手写感/国潮/艺术字 to the nearest calligraphy font.
- Body/UI/captions: prefer catalog faces; invent no font names.
If the user forbids image gen: skip `create_image`; plain `create_text` only.

## genPrompt recipe (concise, concrete)
Include: **subject**, **style/medium**, **lighting/mood**, **composition/camera**, **color cues**, **negatives** (no watermark/logo/extra text unless letteringText).
For letteringText: isolate glyphs; high contrast plate; no busy background behind letters.
Aim for meticulously crafted atmosphere — not generic stock-template vibes.

## Stacking
Hero image first → then `create_text` / UI chrome on quieter regions. Do not invent facts into the picture. Size/transparency details → TOOL_DETAILS.

## Route
| Brief | Also load |
|-------|-----------|
| Poster / roll-up | `poster_craft` |
| Ecommerce product plate | `ecommerce_surface` |
| Taste / anti-slop | `garden_style` |

## Do not
- Fake festive heroes with geometry
- Bake unreadable gibberish text into the image when real `create_text` is needed
- Ignore user “no image gen” constraints
- Paste finished composites that double-print baked titles (see `vision_extract`)

## Done when
Hero/atmosphere exists when required; lettering path respects the 90% gate; prompt is concrete; stacking leaves quiet zones for type.
items.prompt_negative: If the user forbids image gen, do not create_image; do not invent fontFamily outside Available fonts; do not pick a catalog font for hero titles under ~90% similarity; do not hardcode 书法感/手写/国潮 → one calligraphy face; do not ship poster/festive work as shape-only geometry; do not invent logos/watermarks into genPrompt.
